column1: lyrics
hello? To whom would you like to speak?
home, home you say? Yes, yes – just one moment please
I wish there was a way to explain why every time a curtain falls
feelin a desire to run now and disappear into a clearer picture
drown in ivory shades of alabaster rain
skin soaked like a too warm wood stove
guarded by giant fox squirrels
silverquick the air is charging to reinstate the frequency
law of the land turned on its head, axe in hand
take care of yourself and stay in tune – all you need, you have
to travel light so drop the anchour and dive!
enough now! It’s alive – are you a dreamer?
just how far are you willing to go? How deep are the doors you swing wide?
a never ending fall into darkness within darkness
with endless halls with many to call the one name
I saw it today, a future that’s already here
cultivated into high art – to each a pair of lungs, bloodstreams vision
clear of the taint of dead horse suicides and endless talk
there’s gold in the hills – in the back of beyond
christmas lights and cigarettes, can you find your hands?
do the mirrors work? Can you shoot straight? Black and white or technicolour rain?
